changes: Improved popup startup by reading your saved filter, search and cache in one step instead of four.
Improved loading so cached posts appear immediately while the feeds refresh in the background.
Improved startup speed by loading the changelog only when About is opened.
Improved search responsiveness: results update instantly and your search is saved once you pause typing.
Fixed a failed refresh clearing the posts that were already loaded from the cache.
Added Azure Service Update feeds, with status badges.
Fix Education blog feed missing from manifest.
Added service worker for background feed updates.
Added new settings for feed groups.
Improved search functionality to support multiple keywords.
Focus cursor in search box when opened.
Added collapse feature for filters and keyboard shortcuts.
Added Microsoft RSS feed reader popup.
Added settings, help modal, and dark mode support.
